main-bootstrap resolves platform.configDir from explicit environment or the packaged dataFolderName and passes platform.configDir as WORKBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR in daemon environment
server resolves userSkillsDir under configDir/skills; project skill scanning joins cwd, WORKBUDDY_DATA_FOLDER_NAME and skills
